about: FAKE keys, test-only. Remote access through the hub, contract R0 (protocol.md 10.2c, 8.5; #1588).

cases.name: msg1_replayed_into_other_stream

cases.name: msg1_replayed_into_other_workspace
cases.note: a recorded message 1 replayed with another prologue does not open (the prologue binds it)

cases.name: msg1_replayed_for_other_device
cases.note: a recorded message 1 replayed with another prologue does not open (the prologue binds it)

cases.name: msg1_replayed_via_other_hub
cases.note: a recorded message 1 replayed with another prologue does not open (the prologue binds it)

cases.name: msg1_session_replayed_as_enroll
cases.note: a recorded message 1 replayed with another prologue does not open (the prologue binds it)

cases.name: msg1_with_early_data
cases.note: message 1 carries no payload (no early data)

cases.name: msg2_read_from_other_stream
cases.note: a message 2 of another handshake does not open

cases.name: transport_flipped_byte
cases.note: a changed byte fails the AEAD: the stream closes

cases.name: transport_wrong_direction

cases.name: open_unknown_form
cases.note: a key file is not a presence form

cases.name: open_ctap2_up_only
cases.note: a touch without user verification is not enough

cases.name: open_ctap2_counter_decreased
cases.note: the sign counter is recorded and a decrease refused

cases.name: open_fido2_device_with_p256_form
cases.note: a FIDO2 device cannot fall back to a bare signature

cases.name: presence_replayed_into_other_stream
cases.note: presence binds the session's handshake hash

cases.name: presence_replayed_for_other_device
cases.note: same key, other device id

cases.name: presence_nonce_not_issued
cases.note: a used nonce is deleted; an unknown one is the same refusal

cases.name: presence_batch_expired
cases.note: a batch lives 5 min

cases.name: presence_digest_dropped
cases.note: a batch authorizes exactly its list

cases.name: presence_with_open_signature
cases.note: an open signature is never a presence signature (domains)

cases.name: enroll_wrong_code
cases.note: a wrong try; five burn the code

cases.note: the presence signature must be by the named key

cases.name: enroll_kind_swapped
cases.note: the MAC binds the kind

cases.name: enroll_extra_field

cases.name: device_list_empty

cases.name: device_list_65_devices

cases.name: stream_open_w2h

cases.name: frame_cost_small_frame
cases.note: every frame costs at least 1 KiB (signature verification)

cases.name: frame_cost_3000_byte_frame
cases.note: the whole signed frame, signature and base64 included
